raw_text: 中国海警依法对非法侵入仁爱礁海域的菲律宾船只采取必要管控措施。菲方船只无视中方多次警告，擅自进入中国管辖海域，严重侵犯中国主权。中国海警将继续依法维护南海秩序和中国领土主权。China Coast Guard lawfully took necessary control measures against Philippine vessels illegally intruding into Ren'ai Reef waters.
clean_text: Xinhua reports China Coast Guard took control measures against Philippine vessels at Ren'ai Reef. Claims Philippines violated Chinese sovereignty. CCG will continue maintaining South China Sea order.
